blurb: The Museum of Nebraska Major League Baseball is dedicated to illustrating the careers of over 140 men with Nebraska ties who have made it to the Major Leagues of American Baseball. The museum contains artifacts and information on native Nebraskan's and those with Nebraska roots or ties. Major displays on the Hall of Fame players illustrate their baseball careers including trading cards, pictures, and artifacts.
